body:
### 中文更新日志
* **智能中枢 SODA 离线流式 AI 弹幕同传工作台**：
  * **Chromium 官方算法机制对齐**：完整移植官方 GreedyTextStabilizer 动态稳定器、TranslationCache 翻译去重缓存、Wait-K 意群等待策略与 420ms-800ms 时间门控，彻底根治断句切碎、半截词悬挂与无标点复读粘连失真；
  * **提词器双行平滑滚动架构**：构建首行锁定定稿上句 + 次行增量生长的双行滚动模型，消除字幕交替闪退与跳跃感；
  * **苹果级弹幕流光动效与毛玻璃 UI**：实现满行上移 180ms 超临界顺滑平移动画，搭配高质感半透磨砂玻璃字幕卡片与防遮挡避让机制；
  * **全流程模型库按需下载即用**：支持中、英、日、韩、法、德、西、意等多语种高精度离线声学模型库，兼容 CRX3 解包自动平铺，下载完成秒级就绪并自动联动。
* **NAS 媒体库安全掌控与自适应开关**：
  * **内核级只读隔离保护**：废除全盘危险挂载，收敛为 `/mnt/user:ro,rslave` Linux 系统底层强制只读，零拷贝极速提取音轨且彻底杜绝写入风险；
  * **极简自适应 Switch 授权卡片**：打造苹果质感自适应开关卡片，支持随时在 App 内一键安全开启授权与随时撤销，杜绝文字折行与排版挤压；
  * **Docker 真实挂载卷回退探针**：引入 Docker Inspect 底层卷探活机制，保障挂载状态跨网络与断线时权威自洽。
* **文件管理器视频播放器全面重塑**：
  * **分屏与三段式滑动手势交互**：引入 YouTube 分屏布局与 EDL 专业手势（水平微步快进/快退、左侧屏幕亮度调节、右侧音量调节）；
  * **画中画小窗与常驻连播列表**：支持全局悬浮画中画小窗播放与目录同级视频播放列表实时定位与一键切集；
  * **双语字幕智能合并与串帧自愈**：深度整合本地外挂字幕与 AI 同传面板，支持中英双语智能排版；消除切视频事件队列残留，根治历史字幕串帧闪烁。
* **底座镜像架构与安全加固**：
  * **代码混淆与生产环境加固**：`easy-unraid-core` 升级集成 PyArmor 字节码混淆与多阶段优化构建，模型解包自愈与状态上报全链路贯通。

### English Changelog
* **Intelligent Hub SODA Offline Streaming AI Live Caption & Danmaku Studio**:
  * **Chromium Official Algorithm Alignment**: Integrated official GreedyTextStabilizer, TranslationCache, Wait-K segmentation policies, and 420ms-800ms temporal gating, eliminating fragmented clauses, hanging function words, and loop hallucinations;
  * **Teleprompter Dual-Line Smooth Scrolling**: Architected dual-line viewport locking finalized clauses on the top row while growing active text on the bottom row, eradicating abrupt layout shifts;
  * **Supercritical Spring Animations & Frosted Glass UI**: Crafted Apple-grade 180ms line-shift spring physics with high-legibility frosted glass capsule aesthetics;
  * **Zero-Configuration Model Library Management**: Supported 8 high-frequency offline language models (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Italian) with automated CRX3 unbundling and instant activation.
* **NAS Media Library Secure On-Demand Read-Only Authorization**:
  * **Kernel-Level Read-Only Isolation**: Enforced `/mnt/user:ro,rslave` Linux-native read-only access for zero-copy audio extraction with absolute write protection;
  * **Adaptive Switch Card**: Designed Apple-grade adaptive switch cards, empowering instant on-demand authorization and safe revocation with zero text wrap regressions;
  * **Docker Inspect Fallback Probe**: Added real-time host-level inspect fallback to maintain accurate mount telemetry across container restarts.
* **File Manager Video Player Overhaul**:
  * **Split-Screen & Three-Zone Gestures**: Integrated YouTube-inspired split-screen layouts and EDL gesture physics (horizontal scrubbing, left brightness, right volume);
  * **Picture-in-Picture & Video Playlist**: Added global PiP floating window support and contiguous in-folder video playlist navigation;
  * **Smart Bilingual Merging & Residual Guard**: Unified external subtitles and live captions with collision avoidance and purged legacy event queues on media switches.
* **Backend Infrastructure & Container Hardening**:
  * **Code Obfuscation & Security**: Upgraded `easy-unraid-core` with PyArmor bytecode obfuscation, multi-stage Docker builds, and automated model hierarchy self-healing.
